svg.title: Terminal showing Cannot connect to the Docker daemon at unix var run docker.sock, plus two variant wordings
svg.desc: A terminal showing three wordings of the same failure. The classic form reads Cannot connect to the Docker daemon at unix:///var/run/docker.sock. Is the docker daemon running? A newer Docker CLI instead reports failed to connect to the docker API at that socket, telling you to check the path and whether the daemon is running. On Windows the same failure names the named pipe docker_engine rather than a unix socket.
svg.text: Cannot connect to the Docker daemon at unix:///var/run/docker.sock. Is the docker daemon running?
# newer Docker CLI, same cause, completely different wording:
failed to connect to the docker API at unix:///var/run/docker.sock; check if the
path is correct and if the daemon is running
# and on Windows the socket is a named pipe, not a unix socket:
error during connect: this error may indicate that the docker daemon is not
running: open //./pipe/docker_engine: The system cannot find the file specified.
↑ Three wordings, one cause: the CLI found no daemon at the endpoint it was pointed at.
